result.summary: 本文提出 Transformer，一种完全基于注意力机制、摒弃循环与卷积的序列转换网络架构 [S1.p4]。在 WMT 2014 英德与英法翻译任务上，该模型在质量上优于已有最佳结果，同时更易并行且训练时间显著更少 [abstract]。模型在英德任务上达到 28.4 BLEU，超过包括集成模型在内的现有最佳结果 2 BLEU 以上；在英法任务上以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天取得 41.8 的单模型 BLEU [abstract]。作者还将 Transformer 成功应用于英语成分句法分析，表明其可泛化到其他任务 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 主流序列转换模型基于复杂的循环或卷积神经网络，包含编码器和解码器，性能最好的模型还通过注意力机制连接编码器与解码器 [abstract]。注意力机制已成为各类序列建模与转换模型的重要组成部分，能建模输入或输出序列中不受距离限制的依赖关系，但除少数情况外，这类注意力机制都与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。本文旨在提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入与输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder.
In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

method.text: 作者提出 Transformer，完全依靠注意力机制建立输入与输出的全局依赖，摒弃循环与卷积 [S1.p4]。其核心是缩放点积注意力：输入由维度为 d_k 的查询和键、维度为 d_v 的值组成，计算查询与所有键的点积，各自除以 √d_k，再经 softmax 得到值上的权重 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。模型还使用多头注意力，将查询、键、值用不同的学习到的线性投影投影 h 次，并行执行注意力后拼接并再次投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。Transformer 以三种方式使用多头注意力：编码器-解码器注意力、编码器自注意力，以及带掩码以保持自回归性质的解码器自注意力 [S3.SS2.SSS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.
We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections to $d_{k}$, $d_{k}$ and $d_{v}$ dimensions, respectively.
The Transformer uses multi-head attention in three different ways
We need to prevent leftward information flow in the decoder to preserve the auto-regressive property.

experiments.text: 论文在两个机器翻译任务上进行实验，即 WMT 2014 英德和英法翻译任务 [abstract]。英德任务上模型达到 28.4 BLEU，英法任务上以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天取得 41.8 的单模型 BLEU [abstract]。作者还将 Transformer 应用于英语成分句法分析，在大量和有限训练数据两种设置下均成功 [abstract]。在成分句法分析实验中，作者仅在 Section 22 开发集上做了少量实验来选择 dropout、学习率和 beam 大小，其余参数保持与英德基础翻译模型一致，推理时将最大输出长度增至输入长度加 300，beam 大小为 21、α=0.3 [S6.SS3.p3]。

evidence.quote: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.
Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs
We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.
We used a beam size of $21$ and $\alpha=0.3$ for both WSJ only and the semi-supervised setting.

findings.text: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，模型达到 28.4 BLEU，超过包括集成模型在内的现有最佳结果 2 BLEU 以上 [abstract]。在英法任务上，模型以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天建立了 41.8 的单模型 BLEU 新纪录，训练成本仅为文献中最佳模型的一小部分 [abstract]。自注意力层以常数数量的顺序执行操作连接所有位置，而循环层需要 O(n) 顺序操作；当序列长度 n 小于表示维度 d 时，自注意力层比循环层更快 [S4.p4]。作为附带好处，自注意力可能产生更可解释的模型，单个注意力头明显学会执行不同任务，许多头表现出与句子句法和语义结构相关的行为 [S4.p6]。

evidence.quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature.
a self-attention layer connects all positions with a constant number of sequentially executed operations, whereas a recurrent layer requires $O(n)$ sequential operations.
self-attention layers are faster than recurrent layers when the sequence length $n$ is smaller than the representation dimensionality $d$
As side benefit, self-attention could yield more interpretable models.
Not only do individual attention heads clearly learn to perform different tasks, many appear to exhibit behavior related to the syntactic and semantic structure of the sentences.

limitations.text: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，可将自注意力限制为只考虑以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的输入序列邻域，这会把最大路径长度增至 O(n/r)，作者表示计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。作者还计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限的注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

evidence.quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.

We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
